title: Close 3 security gaps found in the design review
summary: Adds REQ-0041 AC2 (chat agent pinned to its project) and AC3 (MCP server enforces the chat deny list itself), and REQ-0040 AC3 (validate client-supplied filesystem paths). Reopens STORY-0005 and STORY-0006 with one task and one security eval each.
rationale: The reverse-engineered design review found three gaps: (1) the chat agent can pass another project's key to MCP tools (workspace.rs:380-389 gives an explicit project priority); (2) only the Claude Code client-side deny list stops write tools, because the MCP server does not check its caller; (3) POST /api/projects/import, POST /api/code/scan and GET /api/impact accept unvalidated filesystem paths. The existing requirements are extended rather than duplicated.

acceptance_criteria.text: 0 write, apply, scan, evidence or shell/file-editing tools are available to the chat agent
Every MCP call from a chat session operates on the project the chat was opened in; a call naming another project is refused with an error and reads or proposes 0 records in it
The MCP server started for a chat session itself refuses every tool on the chat deny list, so 0 records change even if the client-side deny list is bypassed

ops.reason: Close cross-project access and add server-side enforcement

A client-supplied filesystem path is accepted only if, after resolving symlinks, it is a configured component path (code scan root, impact root) or an absolute directory containing reqforge.json (project import); any other path returns 400 and 0 files are read

data.done_when: STORY-0005/E3 passes and REQ-0041 reports verified.

data.title: Validate client-supplied filesystem paths
data.description: Canonicalise and check paths for POST /api/projects/import {path}, POST /api/code/scan {root} and GET /api/impact?root= (server/src/api.rs:381-383, 461-465, 481-484). Tag tests REQ-0040#AC3.
data.done_when: STORY-0006/E4 passes and REQ-0040 reports verified.

stories: STORY-0005 (Changesets and chat bridge) and STORY-0006 (REST, MCP, CLI and console) reopen from done to in-progress; their existing done tasks stay done.
code: server/src/chat.rs (how the chat's MCP server is launched), server/src/mcp.rs (project argument and per-role tool refusal), server/src/workspace.rs (project resolution), server/src/api.rs (path checks on 3 routes).
Existing trace tags REQ-0041#AC1, REQ-0040#AC1 and REQ-0040#AC2 are unchanged and stay verified. New tests in server/tests/integration.rs must be tagged REQ-0041#AC2, REQ-0041#AC3 and REQ-0040#AC3.
evals: 2 new security evals: STORY-0005/E3 and STORY-0006/E4. Existing evals unchanged.
risks: REQ-0040 and REQ-0041 drop from implemented to approved, and their new criteria show as untested, until TASK-0036 and TASK-0037 land.
Path validation could break importing projects from unusual locations; it is limited to directories containing reqforge.json.
The chat assistant (this agent) loses the ability to read other projects, which it does not need.
